summary: BW LPG Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing the sale of the 2015-built BW Levant, acquired in the 2024 Avance Gas transaction. The sale is expected to generate a net book gain of approximately US$17 million and net cash proceeds of around US$38 million. The vessel is scheduled for delivery to the buyer by mid-November. The CEO emphasized disciplined capital allocation and fleet renewal. No board recommendation or advisors were named. This is an opportunistic asset sale, not a broader strategic exit. Watch for the impact of vessel delivery and potential impact on BW LPG's fleet composition.
